datasets.dataset_name: Jaw osteonecrosis peri-lesional imaging mass cytometry balanced starter
datasets.labels: The source supplement describes epithelial, stromal, vascular, cell-type and functional-state annotations. The downloaded raw tables contain spatial marker intensities without operative necrotic, transition or viable-bone boundary masks.
datasets.sample_count_detail: One smallest ROI from each of 6 MRONJ and 8 control subjects.
datasets.clinical_variables_status: No downloadable patient-level age, sex, comorbidity, medication or blood-index table is paired with these ROI files.
datasets.recommended_use: Pathology-scale spatial marker preprocessing, near-condition representation learning, cohort-aware engineering and biological review of gray-zone concepts after explicit admission.
datasets.data_boundary: Human MRONJ peri-lesional pathology-scale proxy. It contains no intraoperative white-light/ICG frames, CBCT, operative bone-surface truth, necrotic-transition-viable surgical masks, or paired clinical variables. It cannot support patient-conditioned segmentation, surgical-boundary, navigation or clinical-performance claims.
